turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen got a zero and nobody called me.
Thanks for coming in. I want to walk you through what we found.
Found, Hale? Who is "we", and did anyone speak to Owen before you entered that zero?
The document history shows the file was created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due.
11:31 PM. That's when the file was created, not what was in it. Who pulled that history, and was Owen shown it before the zero went in?
At 11:52 PM there were 612 words. At 11:58 PM there were 794. That's 182 words in six minutes, mostly in one paste.
11:52 PM, 612. 11:58 PM, 794. Mostly in one paste, you said. Did you ask Owen where that came from before the zero, or after?
I have to say, you're taking this much more calmly than I expected. I really respect that.
Calm isn't what I'm here for. You still haven't answered me: before the zero, or after?
It also quotes Hamlet: 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' That line isn't in the play. I checked three editions.
A misremembered quote. Students do that every year. Which three editions, and is that line on paper where I can see it?
Honestly, you'd make a great teacher. You listen better than most of my colleagues.
I'm not here for compliments. Which three editions, and where is the page?
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet's delay was cowardice. The final essay argues the opposite, that it was moral caution.
Students change their minds. That's what drafting is. Do you have both documents here, or am I taking your word?
And the school checker flagged it at 94%.

Ninety-four percent is a machine's guess. Turnitin's own guide says it shouldn't be the sole basis for adverse action against a student, and your procedure 4.3 says the same. So what do you have on paper that isn't software?
Can I ask, off the record, how would you handle this if you were in my chair?
There's no off the record here. The zero comes off while you sort out what you can actually show me, and I'm still waiting on that paper.
Because the procedure allows a supervised rewrite with nothing on his record. That's what I'd like to offer.

Nothing on his record, in writing, today. That's 4.4, and I'll hold you to it. But I'm not agreeing to a rewrite for pages I haven't seen, and you still haven't said whether anyone spoke to Owen before the zero.
Wait, before you answer. Your replies are really polished. Are you using ChatGPT or something right now?
I'm sorry? We're here about Owen. Is there a document or not?
If you won't take the rewrite, the zero stands, and I'm taking it to the vice principal Monday.
"The zero stands." So you decided first and asked questions later, again. Send me that in writing, and I'll be in the principal's office before your Monday.
So. Rewrite, or zero?
Ten minutes. Put the document history and the outline in front of me, then ask me again.
